Hi Camille,

Yes, here is where both of them stand.

Your Magic Miner 40T (order Shop····) ships October 31, 2026. Your BSB B30 (order Shop····) ships November 7, 2026, along with the Power Kit that was added to that order. Both are paid and nothing else is needed from you. Tracking goes out by email to the address on each order as soon as the label is on the box.

You can follow the batches on their way to our warehouse here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status. Dates there can shift a little as stock moves between warehouses, but those are the dates your two orders are sitting on now.

Thanks for your patience, and tell me if you would like anything else checked.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
Wow, thanks for the quick reply. Can’t wait!!

Hi Camille,

Happy to help, and glad that was useful. Nothing more is needed from you now, the tracking emails will come to this address as each one leaves the warehouse.

I was very happy to help with this. If you were pleased with our service, we would really appreciate a quick review on Trustpilot: https://www.trustpilot.com/review/heliumdeploy.com

You are also very welcome in our Discord, https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf, for the latest products and for help with setup once your units land.

Enjoy them, and just reply here any time.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
I already know the answer but if i wanted to add a 2nd BSB B30 to my order, would that be possible for it to come in the same shipment?Sent from my Galaxy

Hi Camille,

Yes, a second one is easy to add, but I would not combine it with what you have.

Your current B30 is set for November 7. A B30 ordered now shows November 30 for a Canadian address, so putting them in one shipment would mean holding the first unit back three extra weeks. Two separate parcels gets you mining sooner, and there is nothing extra to pay on our side for the second shipment beyond the normal checkout shipping.

The B30 is $899 at heliumdeploy.com/products/bsb-b30, same unit, matched plug for your address. If you do place it, reply here with the new order number and I will keep an eye on both for you and make sure the second one rides the first batch it can.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
Oh my gosh I am in vancouver. Was that expecting to answer back. Thank youSent from my Galaxy

Hi Camille,

Ha, yes, we keep an eye on the inbox well outside Vancouver business hours, so you will usually get an answer quickly whatever the time.

Nothing changes on the dates either way, Vancouver and Surrey are the same side of the country for us: your Magic Miner 40T ships October 31 and your B30 ships November 7, both to the (address hidden) on the orders. If you would rather they went to a Vancouver address instead, just send me the full address and I will update both orders and the warehouse before anything is labelled.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
